summary.executive_summary: Mariana from Altura CRM contacts Roberto to discuss integrating their sales system with inventory management and improving reporting. Roberto, who does not have purchasing authority, raises a price objection at 4,900 MXN per month and mentions they are evaluating a competitor. Mariana proposes a controlled pilot for two users to ease adoption concerns and commits to sending a tailored proposal covering total cost, data security, implementation time, and a competitor comparison. Roberto provides fictional contact details and schedules a Thursday 4:00 PM follow-up so the financial director can participate in the decision.
key_points: Customer currently uses spreadsheets and is evaluating Competitor One as an alternative.
Price objection raised: 4,900 MXN monthly is above budget.
No purchasing authority — financial director has the final decision.
Mariana proposes a 2-user controlled pilot to demonstrate adoption value.
Proposal to include: total cost, data security, implementation timeline, and competitor comparison.
Follow-up call scheduled for Thursday at 4:00 PM with financial director.
Customer dictated fictional contact details during the call.

buying_signals: Customer showed interest in a controlled pilot approach.
Customer agreed to a follow-up meeting.
Customer confirmed the integration requirements align with Altura CRM capabilities.
risks: No purchasing authority — financial director decides.
Active competitor evaluation with Competitor One at a lower price point.
Customer expressed frustration with previous vendor who went unresponsive.
insights.tone_notes: Customer was rushed and mildly frustrated early in the call. Tone improved after Mariana acknowledged concerns and proposed the pilot.
